summary.text: Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins is a Democrat from Sitka who served ten years in the Alaska House of Representatives and was a member of a bipartisan House coalition. His campaign focuses on school funding, fisheries and rebuilding the state ferry system, and he has said he would fill his cabinet one-third each with Democrats, independents and Republicans.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised in Sitka, Alaska; attended Yale University but dropped out to run for the Alaska House.
Served in the Alaska House of Representatives for District 35 (Southeast Alaska) from 2013 to 2023; chaired House State Affairs in the 30th Legislature.
Co-chaired a bipartisan working group on the state's fiscal crisis late in his legislative tenure.
